newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian govt to finish budget review mid-March.
newsitem.headline: Belgian govt to finish budget review mid-March.

text.p: The Belgian government aims to complete the review of its 1997 budget by mid-March, the government said in a statement on Friday.

The government said that the budget will be revised if necessary to keep it on track for cutting the public deficit to 3.0 percent of gross domestic product this year, thus meeting the Maastricht target for a single European currency.

The statement said also the government would review the succes of its policies since it was elected in May 1995 and review future targets. Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene's centre-left cabinet's mandate expires at the end of 1999.
